P4 exact-runtime closure requires ci:p4:probe PASS in both heavy GitHub workflows and aggregate evidence on the same source fingerprint with productionTouched=false.

P4 FULL is runtime-verified on exact-source commit d305ade2050765de86c7f5ef1c54eb7426c5e25b / fingerprint cf6165fcc74e94abb3866230aa1764cee9487d4de6b630377465d20bda7d9246; P4 source is frozen absent regression evidence.
P5 is one atomic visual-product wave across Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal; global CSS-only or marker-only closure is forbidden.

P5 automated closure requires audit:p5:visual plus exact-source ci:p5:probe screenshot evidence for 15 Admin primary workspaces, 14 Admin contextual routes, 4 POS views, 5 Storefront views and 7 Employee Portal views at 1440/1024/390 geometry.
P5 automated PASS does not replace human visual acceptance; A-07 remains IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING until exact-source automated evidence is green and human UI acceptance is recorded separately.

P5 V2 is one atomic presentation-only wave. It must keep business logic/API/domain behavior unchanged while giving Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal visibly distinct art direction, layered glass/elevation, clearer navigation hierarchy, and non-black customer/self-service surfaces.
P5 V2 retains the no-decorative-gradient rule; glass, blur, solid-color ambient glows and shadows are allowed and required by config/p5-v2-art-direction.json.
P5 V2 automated exact-source PASS on fd2d29d9a8d7d6bd0db3c1e085fb4e376440f6bc does not close P5 because the second human visual review rejected the presentation.
P5 V4 is ONE_P5_FULL_V4_TOTAL_PRESENTATION_REBUILD: four product presentation layers are replaced as one atomic wave; piecemeal legacy-skin/CSS override accumulation is forbidden.

P5 V4 is presentation-only: business logic, API contracts, permissions, tenant/branch authority, inventory/accounting/payment/payroll/returns/tax/pricing semantics and canonical mutation paths are frozen.

P5 V4 canonical shells are Tailwind CSS v4 utility-first; globals.css is a replacement compatibility layer, old version override selectors are forbidden, and controlled gradients are allowed only for brand/depth.

P5 V4 exact-source evidence must identify visualGeneration=P5-V4, prove four distinct computed runtime identities plus Admin shell geometry, and keep humanAcceptance=PENDING until explicit human runtime acceptance.
